issues.reason: (To writer criticism) puts two bare kinds in a slot the instruction set defines only for an event witness (or the entity-attached "from" of origin), and To is a seeded purpose head feeding PurposeOf / ReasonFor, so the atom is ill-typed and detaches the complement from the property it modifies.

The atom belongs to the same "most"-quantified empirical generic as the Inheritance atom it modifies, so (STV 1.0 0.99) asserts unrestrictedly what the sentence states of most writers only — the dial gives that claim 0.9 / 0.9.

gaps_confirmed: adjective with a prepositional complement ("sensitive to criticism", "afraid of X", "aware of Y") — preposition-named obliques are defined on an event witness (plus the entity-attached "from"), with no way to attach an adjective's PP argument to a Member / Inheritance property atom
a preposition-named oblique with two bare kinds — the oblique rules assume an event or entity in the first slot; kind-to-kind relations exist only as the lemmatized-verb relational generic
new_gaps: the "leave opaque for now" instruction for adjective compounds (solid_at_room_temperature) does not say whether an argument-taking adjective should fuse into one property symbol or be decomposed, and ConditionalProperty does not cover it ("criticism" is not a condition-state of the writer)
To is a seeded purpose-connective head, so any preposition-named To oblique emitted from a surface "to" collides with the PurposeOf / ReasonFor bridge
repair_summary: Dropped the ill-typed (To writer criticism) and kept the adjective phrase whole as the opaque property sensitive_to_criticism per "leave opaque for now" for adjective compounds, so the predicate slot of the Inheritance atom and of its QuantifierPhrase companion now carries the full property; both truth values are unchanged (0.9 0.9 and 1.0 0.99).
notes: Simply deleting the To atom was not enough: bare (Inheritance writer sensitive) over-asserts, since sensitivity to criticism is not sensitivity in general, so the complement had to stay inside the property symbol rather than be discarded.
